integrity: The proof reduces birationality on the dense torus to generation of the degree-zero character lattice, proves a symbolic lower bound by a two-level factorization argument, and exhibits a lattice basis at the claimed threshold. Finite enumeration is used only as a consistency check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem computes the first birational multiple only for the weighted-projective family \(X_n=\mathbf P(n^2-1,n^2+1,2n^3)\), with even \(n\ge2\). It does not improve the uniform theorem for arbitrary \(\varepsilon\)-lc surfaces or classify the images of smaller systems.
title: Exact birational threshold in the seventh-order weighted-plane family
